title: Modern Ethiopian Vegetarian Platter
community: Modern Ethiopian restaurants — vegetarian fine dining
author: Chef Haile
desc: Modern Ethiopian Vegetarian Platter — the restaurant-presented beyaynetu: Misir Wat (ETH101), Shiro Wat (ETH102), Kik Alicha (ETH103), Gomen (ETH106), Beetroot Salad (ETH117), Avocado Salad (ETH118), and Timatim Selata (ETH119) on a large injera, plated with restaurant precision.
longDesc: The modern Ethiopian vegetarian platter is the beyaynetu presented with restaurant precision — the same ancient dishes, arranged with contemporary care, for an international and local audience that expects both authenticity and beauty.
steps: Make all wats per individual recipes.
Make salads fresh immediately before serving.
Arrange on large injera with restaurant precision: colours alternating, salads at edges.
chefTips: Restaurant presentation: the beetroot's purple, the Misir's red, the Kik's golden, and the Gomen's green should alternate for visual impact.
commonMistakes: Random arrangement — presentation matters in the modern format.
sustainabilityTips: The modern vegetarian platter is 100% plant-based and 100% Ethiopian-sourced.
servedWith: As the modern restaurant's signature fasting meal
culturalNote: The modern Ethiopian vegetarian platter is the dish that has taken Ethiopian food to international fine dining — its extraordinary variety, colour, and nutritional completeness make it one of the most impressive single plates in world cuisine.
